_note: All values a person could want to adjust after delivery, per R85 (§14). Every value here reproduces a value stated in docs/PRD.md; the field-level '_source' comments (in app/README.md's tunables table) point back to the rule. O-item alternatives are listed under 'alternatives' on the same key and are NOT hardcoded elsewhere — the engine and UI read 'default' unless the console (t3) selects an alternative.

floors._formula: floor = 2 * reentryBonusCheddar (R55). Values below are the shipped values (R55) and equal that formula exactly.

tierLadder._note: R62. prizeUSD/prizeCheddar are the headline prize paid from the external pool on a bracket win at that tier. T6's prize is paid as $999,999.92 CASH plus battle stake at 20:1 (R62).

reentry._note: R63. Pay the fee, receive the bonus (added to character stake in Cheddar), when re-entering a tier after a loss (SITTING -> re-enter). Full play-through rake 6.3% is a diagnostic figure over the reentry ladder, not a per-transaction deduction.

pve._note: R57. 'entryPar' (used for the hard cap) is read as the tier's re-entry USD*cheddarPerDollar per tier (R63), since R62 does not define a separate per-tier entry fee beyond T0's summon cost -- see app/README.md gotchas.

loadFundsPresets._note: O8. Multiples of the entry fee (T0 par = $10).

narrator._note: Deterministic local engine (t1) does not call a model; temperature/maxTokens are carried as data for the future live call, per the brief.

gate._note: R51/C9(f2): the ONE source for gate.js's classification, runSimulator.js's pre-registration text, and the console's O-item/threshold display -- a hand edit here (or a console gate-override patch, app/engine/overrides.js) propagates to every one of those surfaces (AC0 workbook row). Read against gate-cell (incumbent, $10) first-bracket completers.

sequentialRule._note: C10(f2): a REAL Lan-DeMets/O'Brien-Fleming-type alpha-spending design (app/engine/alphaSpending.js), one-sided, over information fraction t = completers/maxN. The futility boundary is its own separate, non-spending-derived rule (a fixed conservative z, per the brief). plannedLookNs is the boundary-table schedule shown in the pre-registration panel (R21); the live daily gate itself evaluates continuously at the ACTUAL completers count, not just these table rows.

doorYield._note: R22/C12(f2): the door layer -- impressions -> clicks -> intent clicks -> reservations, ahead of (and feeding) the in-game funnel runSimulator.js already modeled. Theme and price arms each read door yield (intent clicks per 1,000 impressions) as their PRIMARY metric; the band rule below names a winner only when its lead over the runner-up exceeds `leadBandPct`, otherwise the incumbent/$10 holds (R22).
